narrativeAssessment: The new candidate is a connected adventure rather than a management or moral companion. Children, Helena, Thalcave and Thaouka, Paganels fallible scholarship, betrayal, dangers and reunion carry it. Essential/Core coherently stop at Snowy camp with uncertainty. Deep carries the supported late arc and closing comedy. No broad rebuild is requested; the one source contradiction must be corrected.
parityAssessment: Every title/subtitle/body pair read. RU/EN preserve actors, events, motives and outcomes; the required Toline error is shared, not a translation mismatch. Russian assessed as original condensation, not a published translation.

requiredFindings.category: source contradiction / reversal of comic gesture

problematicWording.ru: Учёный хохочет над учебником. Утром Толин исчезает, оставив Элен ветку мимозы, а Паганелю — книгу, из которой выучил свои ответы.
problematicWording.en: The scholar laughs at the textbook. By morning Toline is gone, leaving Helena a mimosa branch and Paganel the book from which he learned his answers.

requiredFindings.effectOnMeaning: The candidate invents the identity of the abandoned book. Toline leaves the corrective Richardson geography Glenarvan has just given him, not his old teaching book. This changes the pointed final action from rejecting the adults corrective gift into leaving them the source of his erroneous lessons. Paganel laughs at the answers; the scene does not show him examining the boys original textbook.

primaryEvidence.edition: Horne English version, Part II, Chapter XII (Toline of the Lachlan)
primaryEvidence.support: Glenarvan offers Richardsons Compendium to correct the wrong ideas; Toline receives it without conviction. Next morning Paganel finds Richardsons Geography in his vest pocket.

requiredFindings.smallestSourceSupportedCorrection: Keep the scene and its position. In both languages make Paganel laugh at Tolines answers, and identify the left-behind book as the corrective geography Glenarvan gave the boy. Briefly establish the gift in the same paragraph so that abandoning it has its supported comic meaning. Preserve the mimosa and departure. No new scene, direct speech, lesson, screen, or count change is needed.
